question: Total revenue by country
sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which customer spent the most?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: List all electronics products with their prices
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price DESC

question: What products were in order 1001?
sql: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1001

question: Average order value by country
sql: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total_amount) as avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
